rule.description: UserACID entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the Top Secret Account entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in Top Secret if the user is not entitled to an account in Top Secret. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to matching accounts in Top Secret. Notice that this may result in the Top Secret account being deleted or disabled.
